note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Equipment is selected by contamination, location, supply and training, and recorded in the matrix.
Comcare's guidance names electricity clearance before the electricity is used.

practicalCriteria: The learner selects equipment by contamination, location, supply and training, and not by capacity.
The learner refuses connection to an unverified supply.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: The electrical supply has not been verified.
The operator is not trained on the equipment.
